item.title: Building a Custom Setup for Less on the Farm
item.description: Create a practical custom setup for your farm without overspending. Follow the project as affordable materials, creative solutions, and hands-on fabrication come together to build a functional system that improves efficiency while keeping costs low. This project demonstrates how careful planning and resourcefulness can deliver reliable results on a budget.
